# battle -- one row per battle.
#
# Replaces balance_battle_slots_effects.txt, which spelled out 26,181 numbered
# slots so that a row could be addressed without an array index. A global
# variable map is keyed by a runtime number, so the index the language was
# missing is available after all: the row counter is the key and each column is
# its own map. The bucket walk, the slot ceiling and the generated file all go.
#
# Read from the save under `variables.map_data`, one container per column:
#
#     map_data={ { name="battle_w"
#                  list={ { key={ type=value identity=<row * 100000> }
#                           value={ ... } } ... } } }
#
# Keys are the row number and come back in no particular order -- sort by key.
# Numbers carry the usual x100000 scale. Rows are paired across columns by key,
# so column A's key 7 and column B's key 7 are the same row.
#
# Columns (21), each a map of its own:
#     w        <- scope:actor.owner
#     l        <- scope:target.owner
#     loc      <- scope:actor.unit_location
#     kl       <- scope:killed_land_units
#     kn       <- scope:killed_navy_units
#     ll       <- scope:lost_land_units
#     ln       <- scope:lost_navy_units
#     d        <- current_date
#     ws       <- scope:war_score
#     w0       <- global_var:bcw0
#     w1       <- global_var:bcw1
#     w2       <- global_var:bcw2
#     w3       <- global_var:bcw3
#     w4       <- global_var:bcw4
#     w5       <- global_var:bcw5
#     l0       <- global_var:bcl0
#     l1       <- global_var:bcl1
#     l2       <- global_var:bcl2
#     l3       <- global_var:bcl3
#     l4       <- global_var:bcl4
#     l5       <- global_var:bcl5
#
# global_var:battle_count is still the row count and still the last key written.

battle_increment_and_log = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = battle_count } }
		set_global_variable = { name = battle_count value = 0 }
	}
	change_global_variable = { name = battle_count add = 1 }

	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = battle_w key = global_var:battle_count value = scope:actor.owner }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = battle_l key = global_var:battle_count value = scope:target.owner }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = battle_loc key = global_var:battle_count value = scope:actor.unit_location }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = battle_kl key = global_var:battle_count value = scope:killed_land_units }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = battle_kn key = global_var:battle_count value = scope:killed_navy_units }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = battle_ll key = global_var:battle_count value = scope:lost_land_units }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = battle_ln key = global_var:battle_count value = scope:lost_navy_units }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = battle_d key = global_var:battle_count value = current_date }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = battle_ws key = global_var:battle_count value = scope:war_score }
	# the fight's number, the one its day rows carry (0 when no unit had one)
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = battle_cid key = global_var:battle_count value = local_var:bdbcid }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = battle_w0 key = global_var:battle_count value = global_var:bcw0 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = battle_w1 key = global_var:battle_count value = global_var:bcw1 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = battle_w2 key = global_var:battle_count value = global_var:bcw2 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = battle_w3 key = global_var:battle_count value = global_var:bcw3 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = battle_w4 key = global_var:battle_count value = global_var:bcw4 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = battle_w5 key = global_var:battle_count value = global_var:bcw5 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = battle_l0 key = global_var:battle_count value = global_var:bcl0 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = battle_l1 key = global_var:battle_count value = global_var:bcl1 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = battle_l2 key = global_var:battle_count value = global_var:bcl2 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = battle_l3 key = global_var:battle_count value = global_var:bcl3 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = battle_l4 key = global_var:battle_count value = global_var:bcl4 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = battle_l5 key = global_var:battle_count value = global_var:bcl5 }
}
